sanskrit: tirobhāvasvarūpaṃ tu kathyamānaṃ vivicyatām / svabhāvāt parameśāno niyatyaniyatikramam spṛśanprakāśate yena tataḥ svacchanda ucyate / niyatiṃ karmaphalayorāśrityaiṣa maheśvaraḥ sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhārānvidhatte@vāntarasthitīn / mahāsarge punaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārānantyaśālini ekaḥ sa devo viśvātmā niyatityāgataḥ prabhuḥ / avāntare yā ca sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiścātrāpyayantritam nojjhatyeṣa vapustyaktaniyatiśca sthito@tra tat / niyatyaiva yadā caiṣa svarūpācchādanakramāt bhuṅkte duḥkhavimohādi tadā karmaphalakramaḥ / tyaktvā tu niyamaṃ kārmaṃ duḥkhamohaparītatām bibhāsayiṣurāste@yaṃ tirodhāne@napekṣakaḥ / yathā prakāśasvātantryāt pratibuddho@pyabuddhavat āste tadvadanuttīrṇo@pyuttīrṇa iva ceṣṭate / yathā ca buddhastāṃ mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ kurvannapi dviṣan hṛdyāste mūḍha evaṃ hi prabuddhānāṃ viceṣṭitam / śrīvidyādhipatiścāha mānastotre tadīdṛśam ye yauṣmāke śāsanamārge kṛtadīkṣāḥ saṃgacchanto mohavaśādvipratipattim / nūnaṃ teṣā nāsti bhavadbhānuniyogaḥ saṅkocaḥ kiṃ sūryakaraistāmarasānām
